metadata.title: MIST: Processed Data, Synthetic Training Features, and Pretrained Models
metadata.description:
This record provides processed datasets, synthetic training features, and pretrained models for MIST: https://github.com/coleygroup/MIST.

The repository is an updated implementation of MIST, originally developed by Goldman and colleagues, with improved support for modern distributed data parallel (DDP) training and optional synthetic-data training. MIST predicts molecular fingerprints from tandem mass spectra using chemical formula transformers.

 

Processed datasets and portable training features

The msg_all.tar.gz and canopus_all.tar.gz archives contain processed spectra, molecular labels, formula assignments, and split definitions for rebuilding features.

The msg_compact.tar.gz and canopus_compact.tar.gz archives contain self-contained features directly consumed by MIST training and evaluation:

  • MassSpecGym (MSG): 194,119 training, 19,429 validation, and 17,556 test rows.

  • CANOPUS: 9,181 training, 401 validation, and 819 test rows.

These counts describe the released compact feature selections. Compact validation and test selections do not necessarily include every collision-energy row in the processed source datasets.

 

Synthetic training features

The msg_synthetic.tar.gz archive contains 78,450,500 feature rows generated from the refined-4M molecular collection. The canopus_synthetic.tar.gz archive contains 40,000,000 feature rows generated from the random-2M molecular collection.

The 4M and 2M labels refer to molecular collections, not spectral feature row counts. Both archives are self-contained and use relative paths, allowing them to be moved between machines without access to the original filesystem.

 

Pretrained models

Four MIST checkpoints provide exponential moving average (EMA) weights for real-only and synthetic-augmented training:

  • mist_msg_noaug.ckpt: MSG real-only model.

  • mist_msg_aug.ckpt: MSG model trained with synthetic augmentation.

  • mist_canopus_noaug.ckpt: CANOPUS real-only model.

  • mist_canopus_aug.ckpt: CANOPUS model trained with synthetic augmentation.

Here, “noaug” means training without synthetic spectra; stochastic peak and intensity regularization may still be used. These are inference checkpoints, rather than complete training-state snapshots for exact training resumption.

The glacier_msg.ckpt and glacier_canopus.ckpt files provide GLACIER weights for synthetic-spectrum inference through the repository’s compatibility implementation. Training MIST with the supplied compact features does not require running GLACIER.

 

Usage

Extract the data archives from the repository root and place checkpoint files under checkpoints/. Installation, training, evaluation, and GLACIER dependency instructions are available at:

https://github.com/coleygroup/MIST

 

Citation

Please cite the original MIST paper when using these resources:

Goldman, S., Wohlwend, J., Stražar, M., Haroush, G., Xavier, R. J., and Coley, C. W. “Annotating metabolite mass spectra with domain-inspired chemical formula transformers.” Nature Machine Intelligence 5, 965–979 (2023).

https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-023-00708-3

Please also acknowledge the applicable source datasets:

MassSpecGym: https://huggingface.co/datasets/roman-bushuiev/MassSpecGym

Original MIST CANOPUS resources: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8316682
